name: Latest
description: Self-updates via Sparkle EdDSA; also updates other Sparkle apps (inherits their key hygiene).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Latest configures its own Sparkle feed with a pinned SUPublicEDKey and uses SPUUpdater to check and install updates for discovered Sparkle app bundles, reading each target bundle's SUFeedURL (with a DevMate fallback). Target-app key configuration and Sparkle runtime enforcement remain delegated and were not independently audited in this snapshot.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; external target-app key material, Sparkle's dependency-level verifier, and historical release artifacts were not independently reverified.
